name: Asake
description:
'''Ahmed Ololade''' ({{Pronunciation|Ahmed_Ololade.wav}}; born 13 January 1995), known professionally as '''Asake''', is a Nigerian singer, rapper, and songwriter. Asake initially rose to fame in 2022 with the song "Omo Ope" with [[Olamide]]. In February 2022, he released his debut EP, ''Ololade Asake'' under Olamide’s YBNL Nation''.''

This was followed by his debut album, ''[[Mr. Money with the Vibe]]'' (2022), which debuted at number one on the [[TurnTable Top 100 Albums|''TurnTable'' Top 100]] chart and number 66 on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]] chart. He continued this success with his second album, ''[[Work of Art (album)|Work of Art]]'' (2023). Asake's third album, ''[[Lungu Boy]]'' (2024), became his third consecutive number one album in Nigeria and the longest-running number one on the Nigerian chart history at the time.

Asake released the collaborative EP ''[[Real, Vol. 1]]'' with [[Wizkid]] in 2026, and all five of its tracks debuted in the top five on the [[TurnTable Top 100 Songs|''Turntable'' Top 100]] Songs chart. Asake's fourth album, ''[[M$ney]]'' released in May 2026, which surpassed ''Lungu Boy'' as the longest running number-one in Nigeria. In July 2026, Asake released the [[live album]] ''M$ney (Live in London)'' in collaboration with [[Spotify]].

He has been nominated for over [[Asake#Awards and nominations|thirty-five accolades]] and holds the record for the most number-one songs in Nigeria, with 14. and was the country's most streamed artist from 2022 to 2025.
